content: अपकर्षण {%a.%} Taking or drawing away, removing, diminishing (<ab>opp.</ab> वर्धक); न चास्ति सदृशं तेन किंचित्स्थौल्यापकर्षणम् <ls>Suśr.</ls> .{@-णम्@} .²1 Removing, taking away; drawing away or down, depriving (one) of, drawing out, extracting. .²2 Lessening, making inferior, detraction. .²3 Superseding. .²4 Denying; abolishing.
